title: Sustainability Facts Schema
description: Schema for extracting sustainability facts from hotel websites.

solar_panels_used.description: True if solar panels are mentioned as being used.

led_lighting_used.description: True if LED lighting is mentioned as being used.

renewable_energy_sources.description: List of specific renewable energy sources mentioned (e.g., 'wind', 'geothermal').

energy_reduction_targets.description: Description of any stated energy reduction targets.

water_saving_fixtures.description: True if water-saving fixtures (e.g., low-flow showers) are mentioned.

linen_reuse_program.description: True if a linen reuse program is mentioned.

rainwater_harvesting.description: True if rainwater harvesting is mentioned.

water_reduction_targets.description: Description of any stated water reduction targets.

recycling_program.description: True if a general recycling program is mentioned.

plastic_reduction_initiatives.description: List of specific plastic reduction initiatives (e.g., 'no single-use plastics', 'refillable toiletries').

food_waste_reduction.description: True if food waste reduction efforts are mentioned.

composting_program.description: True if a composting program is mentioned.

local_sourcing_food.description: True if sourcing food locally is mentioned.

local_employment_initiatives.description: True if supporting local employment is mentioned.

community_support_programs.description: Description of any programs supporting the local community.

eco_certifications.description: List of specific eco-certifications mentioned (e.g., 'Green Key', 'Travelife').

other_sustainability_badges.description: List of other sustainability badges or awards mentioned.

evidence_snippets.description: Snippets from the website that serve as evidence for the extracted facts.
